t_advice_summary_textbox.text: To keep a look out on the colour change of the gnomes, once you keep focus on the colour change. You will figure out which gnome gives the most mushrooms in each game round.

vb_textbox.text: The gnomes have different colours which is crucial to choose wisely, one of them clearly gives more mushrooms, than the other. Keep much attention on choosing the one you feel has the most mushrooms. It's all about trusting your instincts and go with your first thought instead of thinking it through, you don't have much time to decide so thinking fast and critically is the skill that is needed for this game.
